description: Opens the user's Saved Weeks for visual browsing or picking a week to reuse, with savedWeekId and up to three dinner previews per card. Counts and duplicate comparisons are available through analyse_saved_weeks; get_saved_week reads the complete dinners of one week without opening a draft. Pass nextOffset as offset until hasMore is false to browse all weeks. Collect all pages before editing; restart if records change during the read. A week saved earlier in this conversation is identified by the savedWeekId save_week returned, not by its position or recency in this list. Provenance is not recorded for personal snapshots; never infer Chef IQ origin from a title. Read-only. Requires a linked Chop It account.

offset.description: Start at 0, then pass nextOffset from the previous page. Read every page before proposing whole-library changes; restart if records change while browsing.

name: list_saved_weeks
title: Find saved weeks
